2025-09-30 — [the 24/7 interoperable instant-payment platform launched across all eight UEMOA states, designed to serve individuals, merchants, businesses and public administrations](2025-09-30-lancement-pi-spi-bceao).

2026-03-01 — [an operator opened the service to its own customers](2026-03-01-moov-africa-pi-spi-service).

2026-04-02 — the central bank [reports 80 institutions connected and serving the public, 42 more in real-condition testing, and a 30 June 2026 deadline for full connection](2026-04-02-bceao-connexion-pi-spi). Cross-border functionality here is a regional rail Benin sits on rather than a national instrument.

summary: The instant-payment rail [is designed to serve businesses and public administrations as well as individuals](2025-09-30-lancement-pi-spi-bceao). No business or government transaction volume is published.
developments:
2025-09-30 — [the rail launched with individuals, merchants, businesses and public administrations named in its own design scope](2025-09-30-lancement-pi-spi-bceao).

What is not held is any measure of use by those two classes: no B2B or B2G transaction count, value or share appears anywhere on this ledger, so what can be stated is the functionality and not its uptake.

summary: The foundational identity [was linked to at least 19 national and regional services by February 2025](2025-03-14-world-bank-wuri-benin-isrr), and the register behind it now [runs about 200,000 authentications a day](2026-02-02 Benin reports 75% of identification services accessed through digital platforms).
developments:
2025-03-14 — the foundational identity [was linked to at least 19 national or regional public and private services, including microcredit, two safety-net programmes and mobile-money and SIM registration](2025-03-14-world-bank-wuri-benin-isrr).

2026-02-02 — the register [serves more than 80 institutions at about 200,000 authentications a day, with 25m eKYC verifications in 2025](2026-02-02 Benin reports 75% of identification services accessed through digital platforms). Reuse is the strongest-evidenced part of the identity stack here.

summary: [The law requires every birth to be entered in the national register, with a personal identification number assigned on that registration](2021-01-06-loi-2020-34-etat-civil-dematerialise); the single-window pilot [reached 76.56% against about 22% nationally](2026-02-25-gouv-bj-guichet-unique-bilan-six-mois).
developments:
The founding instrument [requires every birth to be entered in the Registre national des personnes physiques and gives the child a personal identification number on that registration](2021-01-06-loi-2020-34-etat-civil-dematerialise).

2026-02-25 — six months into the single-window pilot, [the window was live in ten health facilities and had removed the parents' separate trip to an identification centre](2026-02-25-gouv-bj-guichet-unique-bilan-six-mois). The instrument is a decade old and the delivery is a ten-facility pilot; the gap between them is the finding.

summary: [Secure birth certificates are now produced from the national register's own data](2026-05-06-anip-rnpp-actes-naissance-securises), and the single window [removed the separate trip to an identification centre](2026-02-25-gouv-bj-guichet-unique-bilan-six-mois).
developments:
2026-05-06 — an agency instruction [formalises that secure birth certificates are produced from register and civil-registry data, and that enrolment requires a birth certificate or supplementary judgment plus reconstitution of old certificates](2026-05-06-anip-rnpp-actes-naissance-securises).

2026-02-25 — [the single window removed the structurally blocking step, the parents' trip to an identification centre after a birth](2026-02-25-gouv-bj-guichet-unique-bilan-six-mois).

The two registers are joined in procedure as well as in law, which is what this indicator asks.

summary: [One agency holds identity, population, civil and electoral registers](2026-05-12-biometricupdate-id4africa-2026-benin-anip-governance) under [the 2018 decree setting its attributions](2018-06-06-decret-2018-206-anip-attributions); a durable funding model [is still being defined](2026-09-02-wearetech-benin-expert-identite-numerique).
developments:
The arrangement [was founded by the 2018 decree setting the identification agency's attributions](2018-06-06-decret-2018-206-anip-attributions) and [places identity, population, civil and electoral registers under that one agency](2026-05-12-biometricupdate-id4africa-2026-benin-anip-governance).

2026-09-02 — what is not settled is how it pays for itself: [an international expert was sought to define a durable model for the identity system as digital public infrastructure](2026-09-02-wearetech-benin-expert-identite-numerique). Maintenance is nationally held and not yet nationally funded.

summary: The cadastre [reached complete coverage in its first commune](2026-09-04-ben-cadastre-a-parakou-196-474-parcelles-enregistrees-les-pays-b), and the national land programme [opened its first multi-actor workshops in March 2026](2026-03-19-bembereke-ateliers-terra-benin).
developments:
2026-03-26 — the cadastre [held about 445,000 parcels](2026-03-26-andf-e-foncier-cadastre-national-445000-parcelles).

2026-09-04 — [Parakou became the first commune with complete cadastral coverage, at 196,474 parcels](2026-09-04-ben-cadastre-a-parakou-196-474-parcelles-enregistrees-les-pays-b).

2026-03-19 — [the land governance programme opened its first multi-actor workshops, run by the land agency with UN technical support in the preparatory phase](2026-03-19-bembereke-ateliers-terra-benin). A cadastre in production and a governance programme still in preparation are the two halves of the position.

summary: A university framework agreement with the innovation hub [was renewed for five years in June 2026](2026-06-01-sorbonne-universite-fr-partenariat-seme-city), and the [Cotonou declaration was adopted in November 2025](2025-11-18-numerique-gouv-bj-declaration-cotonou).
developments:
2025-11-18 — [the Cotonou declaration was adopted](2025-11-18-numerique-gouv-bj-declaration-cotonou).

2026-06-01 — [the framework agreement between a French university and the government-backed innovation hub was renewed for five years, covering AI training, joint research and a planned innovation-management master's](2026-06-01-sorbonne-universite-fr-partenariat-seme-city). Both are cooperation instruments rather than financed commitments.

summary: The first national vulnerability report [records 878 vulnerabilities, 23% critical, 832 leaked-password incidents and 6-87% compliance across public institutions](2025-07-01-asin-bj-rapport-vulnerabilites-cyberespace); a [cyberdrill tested about 100 professionals in June 2026](2026-06-26-gouv-bj-crssi-2026-cyberdrill).
developments:
2025-07-01 — the first national report on cyberspace vulnerabilities and incidents, covering 2021 to 2024, [records 878 vulnerabilities of which 23% critical, 832 leaked-password incidents, and security-policy compliance between 6% and 87% across public institutions](2025-07-01-asin-bj-rapport-vulnerabilites-cyberespace). It is the first time the position was measured at all.

2026-06-26 — [a one-day cyberdrill tested around 100 public- and private-sector professionals against realistic incident scenarios](2026-06-26-gouv-bj-crssi-2026-cyberdrill). Testing is now routine; what the report leaves standing is [a compliance floor of 6% across public institutions](2025-07-01-asin-bj-rapport-vulnerabilites-cyberespace).

summary: [Nearly 100 ministerial IT staff were trained to run the national network and data centre](2021-10-05-numerique-gouv-bj-assi-prscg-formation), and [a further training school opened in Cotonou in December 2025](2025-12-01-ecolenumerique-bj-d-clic-cotonou-lancement).
developments:
The baseline [is a 2021 programme that equipped nearly 100 ministerial IT directors, engineers and specialists to operate the newly built national network and data centre](2021-10-05-numerique-gouv-bj-assi-prscg-formation).

2025-12-01 — [courses opened at a digital-skills school in Cotonou](2025-12-01-ecolenumerique-bj-d-clic-cotonou-lancement). The capacity is trained rather than counted: no figure for how many of those staff remain in post appears anywhere on this ledger.

summary: The municipal services platform [went live and is piloted in three communes of 77](2025-10-02-numerique-gouv-bj-e-communes-lancement), and [one town hall was equipped with solar power, network connectivity and an official site](2026-07-18-lemondelocal-bante-mairie-connectee).
developments:
2025-10-02 — [the e-Communes platform is operationally live, providing the ICT backbone for online municipal services piloted in three communes ahead of a planned national rollout across all 77](2025-10-02-numerique-gouv-bj-e-communes-lancement).

2026-07-18 — [a town hall was equipped with solar power, national administrative network connectivity and an official municipal website](2026-07-18-lemondelocal-bante-mairie-connectee). Three communes of 77 is the number that matters, and the rollout beyond them is planned rather than dated.

summary: [A 2018 decree set the terms for taking the civil registry off paper](2018-10-10-sgg-decret-2018-471-dematerialisation-etat-civil); the [single window has run in ten health facilities since 2025](2026-02-25-gouv-bj-guichet-unique-bilan-six-mois).
developments:
The framework [was set by decree in October 2018](2018-10-10-sgg-decret-2018-471-dematerialisation-etat-civil).

2025-08-18 — [the identification agency's civil-registry platforms were extended and demonstrated ahead of the 2026 elections](2025-08-18-gouv-bj-elections-2026-plateformes-anip).

2026-02-25 — [the single window for birth declaration was live in ten health facilities and had removed a structurally blocking step](2026-02-25-gouv-bj-guichet-unique-bilan-six-mois). Local records are being digitised through national platforms rather than by the communes themselves.

summary: [The 2018 decree covers taking the registry off paper, nationally](2018-10-10-sgg-decret-2018-471-dematerialisation-etat-civil), and the [single window runs in ten health facilities](2026-02-25-gouv-bj-guichet-unique-bilan-six-mois). No count of rural registry offices reached is published.
developments:
The instrument [is national and does not distinguish rural offices](2018-10-10-sgg-decret-2018-471-dematerialisation-etat-civil).

2026-02-25 — [the single window operates in ten health facilities](2026-02-25-gouv-bj-guichet-unique-bilan-six-mois), which is where birth declaration now happens rather than at a registry office at all.

What is absent is any figure for rural registry offices equipped or connected, so the movement is stateable and its rural reach is not.

summary: [Health data is entered on the national platform from every health zone](2020-03-01-instad-annuaire-statistiques-sanitaires-2019), and [nearly 16,000 community health workers captured household data on tablets in the 2026 net campaign](2026-04-25-who-afro-digitalization-mosquito-net-campaign).
developments:
The baseline [is national health-data collection on a digital platform introduced in 2014, with entry at every health zone including peripheral ones](2020-03-01-instad-annuaire-statistiques-sanitaires-2019) — aggregate statistical reporting rather than electronic records at each clinic.

2025-11-21 — [telemedicine was reported as part of a new proximity-health approach](2025-11-21-lanouvelletribune-telemedecine-alafia).

2026-04-25 — [nearly 16,000 community health workers ran a tablet-based data capture across households nationwide during the mosquito-net campaign](2026-04-25-who-afro-digitalization-mosquito-net-campaign). Capture across the whole territory is established; records held at each clinic are not.

summary: [Digital classrooms were placed in northern primary schools from 2019](2019-11-11-gouv-bj-classes-numeriques-ecoles-primaires-nikki), and [teacher training ran across 46 centres in six mostly rural northern departments in 2026](2026-07-01-journaldubenin-formation-informatique-nord).
developments:
2019-11-11 — [digital classrooms were launched in primary schools in the north](2019-11-11-gouv-bj-classes-numeriques-ecoles-primaires-nikki).

2026-07-01 — [a ministry-backed digital-skills campaign trained primary teachers across 46 centres in six mostly rural northern departments](2026-07-01-journaldubenin-formation-informatique-nord). The later record is teacher skills rather than equipment delivered, and no count of schools equipped is published at either end.

summary: [The police information system was extended beyond the capital from 2019](2019-03-22-dgpr-sipao-extension-parakou), [the fingerprint system entered service](2025-10-01-dgpr-afis-mise-en-exploitation), and [300 officers were trained across six cities](2026-07-08-dgpr-asin-formation-300-policiers).

summary: [21 spatialised agropastoral indicators were built from satellite land-cover maps over about 98,000 km²](2026-05-13-cahiersagricultures-fr-obsydya-indicateurs), and the observatory [was placed inside the agriculture ministry](2026-04-14-cirad-fr-obsydya-observatoire).

progress: No change, the agency stands and the published use is external research
summary: [The meteorological agency was founded by decree in 2015](2015-09-07-sgg-gouv-bj-decret-2015-482-meteo-benin); the only published use of satellite precipitation data over Benin [is an external research assessment](2026-02-11-doi-org-qjrms-satellite-precipitation-benin).
developments:
[The agency was founded by decree of 7 September 2015](2015-09-07-sgg-gouv-bj-decret-2015-482-meteo-benin) and nothing in the period changed its position.

2026-02-11 — [a peer-reviewed assessment of satellite precipitation products over Benin was published](2026-02-11-doi-org-qjrms-satellite-precipitation-benin). It is research about the country rather than an operational product the agency runs, which is the distinction this indicator turns on.

summary: A public institution [issued a procurement notice to integrate its directory with a US hyperscaler's cloud identity stack](2026-05-28-cdcb-bj-entra-id-tender). No signed engagement is held.

summary: [A regional information-society conference was held in February 2026](2026-02-10-eeas-europa-eu-ipris-conference) and [an Africa-Connect digital campus was announced in March](2026-03-12-expertisefrance-fr-africa-connect-digital-campus). No bilateral digital instrument with Benin is held.
developments:
2026-02-10 — [a regional information-society conference was convened](2026-02-10-eeas-europa-eu-ipris-conference).

2026-03-12 — [an Africa-Connect digital campus was announced](2026-03-12-expertisefrance-fr-africa-connect-digital-campus).

Both are regional programmes Benin participates in. No MoU, financing agreement or commitment naming Benin bilaterally appears anywhere on this ledger.

summary: The broadband programme [was founded by decree in 2015](2015-07-03-sgg-decret-2015-378-pdi2t) and [the Cotonou declaration was adopted in November 2025](2025-11-18-numerique-gouv-bj-declaration-cotonou). No separate broadband strategy is adopted.
developments:

2025-11-18 — [the Cotonou declaration was adopted](2025-11-18-numerique-gouv-bj-declaration-cotonou). What the base does not hold at either end of the period is a broadband strategy document with targets against it.

summary: A national digital public infrastructure roadmap [was drafted in July 2026 on a once-only principle](2026-07-31-benin-dpi-roadmap). No data governance policy instrument is adopted.
developments:
2026-07-31 — [a national roadmap was drafted to link fragmented government systems around a once-only principle, its authors naming governance and coherence as the hard part](2026-07-31-benin-dpi-roadmap).

2025-11-18 — [the Cotonou declaration was adopted](2025-11-18-numerique-gouv-bj-declaration-cotonou), a regional instrument rather than a national policy. Governance is being addressed through a roadmap and a declaration; no data governance policy has been adopted.

progress: No change, the code stands and enforcement is reported against it
summary: The digital code's cybersecurity provisions stand; the investigation centre [reported its 2025 activity](2026-01-16-africaho-cnin-bilan-2025) and [an international operation ran in December 2025](2025-12-19-interpol-operation-sentinel).
developments:
The operative instrument is the digital code and nothing in the period amended it.

2026-01-16 — [the national digital investigations centre published its 2025 activity report on online offences](2026-01-16-africaho-cnin-bilan-2025). Both are enforcement under the existing statute, which is why the legislative position reads as unchanged.

progress: No change, the code stands and a broadcasting obligation was added under it
summary: The information and communication code stands; the broadcasting regulator [made carriage of public-interest messages obligatory on 23 December 2025](2025-12-23-hc2tv-haac-decision-diffusion-obligatoire).
developments:
The operative instrument is the information and communication code and nothing in the period amended it.

2025-12-23 — [the broadcasting regulator published a decision obliging media to carry public-interest messages issued by government or on the regulator's order](2025-12-23-hc2tv-haac-decision-diffusion-obligatoire). That is an obligation to broadcast rather than a right to obtain, and it is the only movement the period records on this indicator.

summary: One operator [committed more than US$215m through 2026](2025-05-08-mtn-benin-investment-forum-2025), a privately financed solar-and-data-facility project [signed definitive agreements](2025-08-07-greenline-tech-grand-parakou-agreements), and [a regional venture fund was approved](2026-02-27-afdb-saviu-ii-fund-approval).
developments:
2025-05-08 — [an operator confirmed committed private investment of more than US$215m through 2026 covering 5G rollout, fibre expansion and a new headquarters](2025-05-08-mtn-benin-investment-forum-2025).

2025-08-07 — [definitive agreements were signed for a privately financed 10 MW solar plant paired with a carrier-neutral data facility](2025-08-07-greenline-tech-grand-parakou-agreements), with construction pending notice to proceed.

2026-02-27 — [a regional venture fund was approved](2026-02-27-afdb-saviu-ii-fund-approval). The operator commitment is the only one of the three with a figure attached to Benin alone.

summary: The earlier regional connectivity project [closed](2018-01-12-world-bank-warcip-benin-icr) and [a second was approved in March 2026 at US$137m across three countries](2026-03-10-worldbank-wardip2-press-release). No bandwidth figure for Benin is published.
developments:
[The first regional connectivity project reached its implementation completion report in January 2018](2018-01-12-world-bank-warcip-benin-icr).

2026-03-10 — [a second operation under the same regional programme was approved, at US$137m across Benin, Liberia and Sierra Leone](2026-03-10-worldbank-wardip2-press-release).

What neither record carries is a capacity figure: no international bandwidth in gigabits per second, and no price per megabit, appears anywhere on this ledger.

summary: The national data centre [is in service](2021-06-01-numerique-gouv-bj-datacenter-national-tests) and a privately financed carrier-neutral facility [signed definitive agreements](2025-08-07-greenline-tech-grand-parakou-agreements). No rack or megawatt figure is published.
developments:
[The national data centre at Abomey-Calavi was under commissioning with tier certification in progress, secured power and dual fibre](2021-06-01-numerique-gouv-bj-datacenter-national-tests).

2025-08-07 — [definitive agreements were signed for a Tier III-ready, carrier-neutral data facility in Parakou paired with a 10 MW solar plant](2025-08-07-greenline-tech-grand-parakou-agreements), commissioning still ahead.

2026-03-10 — [a regional digital integration operation was approved that funds this layer](2026-03-10-worldbank-wardip2-press-release). One state facility in service and one private facility financed is the position; neither publishes capacity.

summary: Off-site backup [is provided for in the appraisal of the second regional digital integration project](2026-02-16-world-bank-wardip2-pad). No operating off-site backup is recorded.
developments:
2026-02-16 — [the project appraisal document for the second regional digital integration operation provides for this layer](2026-02-16-world-bank-wardip2-pad).

Nothing on this ledger records an off-site backup in operation, a second site holding a copy of state data, or a recovery objective for either. The movement is an appraisal, not a capability.

summary: The national data centre [was commissioned with secured electrical power](2021-06-01-numerique-gouv-bj-datacenter-national-tests); a [50 MW / 160 MWh storage order was placed to smooth solar output](2026-06-25-toyota-tsusho-battery-storage-benin).
developments:

summary: The utility [publishes 2025 outage indices for Cotonou of SAIDI 12.78 and SAIFI 3.35](2026-02-06-sbee-bj-saifi-saidi-2025), and [a 50 MW / 160 MWh storage order was placed](2026-06-25-toyota-tsusho-battery-storage-benin).

2026-06-25 — [a 50 MW / 160 MWh battery storage order was placed to smooth solar output](2026-06-25-toyota-tsusho-battery-storage-benin).

summary: The laboratory system deployed in Benin [added direct transfer to the national health platform](2026-03-26-labbook-3-6-dhis2), and Benin [is one of 18 states working to establish interoperability with a regional health data hub](2026-03-27-who-afro-regional-health-data-hub-progress).

The hub itself is not yet operating, so what moved is Benin's side of the connection.

summary: The examinations office [moved diploma, certificate and transcript requests onto an online platform](2025-09-26-bac-digitizes-online-platform), and the education council [recommended integrating special-needs and female-enrolment data into the national platform](2026-07-21-cne-quinze-recommandations-educmaster).
developments:

One is delivered and one is a recommendation, which is the distance still to run.

summary: The social register [was scoped and financed](2023-11-22-anip-rsu-bientot-realite), the safety net programme [launched](2025-10-18-lancement-gbessoke-programme), and the identity register [now underpins both](2026-02-25-gouv-bj-guichet-unique-bilan-six-mois).

summary: The national services portal [carries suggestion and problem-reporting functions](2025-01-01-service-public-bj-portail-national), [a free police line opened](2025-11-07-dgpr-bj-numero-117), and [a national living-environment platform launched](2026-02-03-gouv-bj-229-cadre-de-vie).

2026-01-29 — [a national platform was launched to bring citizen voice into living-environment management](2026-02-03-gouv-bj-229-cadre-de-vie).

Three channels exist and none of the three publishes how much feedback it receives or resolves.

summary: Budget transparency [scores 77 out of 100 with 52 on participation](2026-06-18-gouv-bj-open-budget-survey-2025), on a communal framework [in place since 1999](1999-01-15-sgg-gouv-bj-loi-97-029-communes).
developments:

summary: The gender-equality council [was established by decree in 2013](2013-02-11-sgg-gouv-bj-decret-2013-51-cnpeeg) and a women's entrepreneurship and access-to-finance project [was announced in November 2025](2025-11-26-pmepe-gouv-bj-wedaf).
developments:
[The national council for gender equality was established by decree in February 2013](2013-02-11-sgg-gouv-bj-decret-2013-51-cnpeeg).

2025-11-26 — [the government announced a women's entrepreneurship and access-to-finance project with World Bank support](2025-11-26-pmepe-gouv-bj-wedaf).

Neither publishes a digital gender gap: no sex-disaggregated figure for connectivity, device ownership or service use appears on this ledger.

summary: The employment agency and a disability organisation [defined the parameters of a targeting platform in January 2026](2026-01-27-anpe-bj-prics-plateforme-ciblage). The platform is not built.

2026-01-27 — [a workshop defined the parameters for a targeting platform, run by the national employment agency with a disability organisation](2026-01-27-anpe-bj-prics-plateforme-ciblage).

That is the whole of what the base holds on this indicator: a design workshop. No accessibility standard for public digital services, and no count of disabled users reached by any of them, appears anywhere.

2026-05-13 — [the Council of Ministers approved the national development plan for 2026 to 2035, with explicit monitoring indicators including a Gini index and a rule-of-law index](2026-05-13-sgg-gouv-bj-conseil-ministres-pnd-2026-2035). The strategy itself is absent: no current national strategy for the development of statistics, and no dated successor to one, is on this ledger.

developments:

summary: [The 2024 banking statute subjects payment and electronic-money institutions to licensing, permitted operations and supervision](2024-09-02-sgg-loi-2024-14-reglementation-bancaire); the regional instant-payment instruction [applies alongside it](2025-09-30-bceao-pi-spi-lancement).
developments:
[The statute enacted on 2 September 2024 is the national-law baseline: it expressly subjects payment institutions and electronic-money institutions operating in Benin to licensing, permitted-operations and supervision rules](2024-09-02-sgg-loi-2024-14-reglementation-bancaire).

2025-09-30 — [the regional instant-payment platform launched under the central bank's own directly applicable instruction](2025-09-30-bceao-pi-spi-lancement), which is the other half of the legal basis and is not Beninese law.
